# P3BR1 Composer review (read-only)

**Verdict: APPROVE** — No blocking P0–P1 issues found on disk. P3BR1 changes align with the packet; one optional **P2** traceability gap below (non-blocking for security/publication).

---

## Scope reviewed

- Packets: `P3B-six-canonical-hubs.md`, `P3BR1-hub-acceptance-and-baseline-remediation.md`, `P3BR1-worker-report.md`
- Modified: `hub-query.ts`, `schema-contract.test.ts`, `p3b-hubs.test.ts`, `p3b-hubs-ui.test.ts`
- Supporting (unchanged but in path): `hub-project.ts`, `hub-types.ts`, `match-keys.ts`, `access.ts`, `routes.ts`, `nav.ts`, `HubViews.tsx`, `HubRoutePage.tsx`, `AppShell.tsx`, `not-found.tsx`, `proxy.ts`, `project-content.ts`, `buildContentIndexes` learner facade

---

## P0–P1 domains

| Area | Assessment |
|------|------------|
| **Learner index / artifact membership** | `ContentIndexes.byKind` / `byId` are learner-published-only (`build.ts` ~1323–1342, 1538–1540). Hub projection unions `HUB_KIND_MEMBERSHIP` + `projectHubRecord` enforces `publicationStatus === "published"` and `hubDestinationFor` hub match (`hub-project.ts` 109–155, 158–172). Tests: independent sets, artifact ID equality, per-kind counts (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 101–115, 149–166, 168–184, 229–248). |
| **Review / draft / blocked / private / audio / secrets** | Fail-closed at projection; recursive string/key scan vs `openAuthorIndexes` statuses + `KNOWN_REVIEW_ONLY_IDS` (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 186–227). Runtime load checks published + destination (`access.ts` 27–62). Web app does not import `openAuthorIndexes`. |
| **Deterministic projection** | `stableStringify` + sorted keys (`hub-project.ts` 236–261); build script uses same serializer (`project-content.ts` 29–31). Test: byte identity + SHA (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 265–275). |
| **Query sanitization / German matching** | `firstParam` for arrays (`hub-query.ts` 28–40); `sanitizeHubQueryText` drops C0/surrogates/`<>`, caps at `HUB_QUERY_MAX_LENGTH` (46–57); lesson/category fail-safe (59–88). `queryMatchKeys` mirrors content `germanMatchKeys` (`match-keys.ts` vs `normalize.ts` 56–64). Display stays canonical (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 317–346). Adversarial suite (`403–462`). |
| **SSR reflection** | Parsed state only in `HubListView` (`HubViews.tsx` 217–218); summary uses sanitized `query.q` (`hub-query.ts` 162–166); React text/`defaultValue` for search input (`HubViews.tsx` 148–152). UI test (`p3b-hubs-ui.test.ts` 182–202). |
| **Route canonicalization / detail 404** | Hub list + `/hubs` in `resolveLearnerRoute`; detail/extra segments → `not-found` (`routes.ts` 93–115). Cases in `p3b-hubs.test.ts` 277–290; smoke covers hubs 200 + detail 404 (`smoke-canonical-routes.mjs` 109–134). Proxy matcher includes hub paths (`proxy.ts` 37–54). |
| **aria-current / mobile Hubs / a11y** | `shellCurrentMatches`: bottom `hubs` current for all hub nav keys (`nav.ts` 35–45). `not-found.tsx` uses `current={null}` (6–7). Tests: one `main`, aria counts, 404 zero current, disabled nav (`p3b-hubs-ui.test.ts` 56–180). |
| **Windows CLI timeout** | `CLI_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS` on `spawnSync` + explicit spawn/timeout errors (`schema-contract.test.ts` 27–63); describe-level Vitest timeout (`535–568`); assertions preserved including path/secret guards (`538–547`). |

---

## Optional P2 (non-blocking)

**Empty hubs omit filter UI (P3B wording vs implementation)**  
`HubListView` branches on `hub.itemCount === 0` and only renders `HubEmptyPublished`, not search/lesson/category (`HubViews.tsx` 235–237). P3B asks each hub page to expose filters; P3BR1 tests empty vs no-match honesty (`p3b-hubs-ui.test.ts` 119–137) but not filters on empty grammar/listening/concepts. Acceptable if orchestrator treats “no items” as filterless; otherwise a small follow-up.

**Committed artifact vs leak scan**  
Recursive leak scan runs on `serializeHubProjectionDeterministic(hubs)` (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 186–188), not a separate `readFileSync(generatedHubsPath)` blob walk. Build path writes the same serializer (`project-content.ts` 29–31), and ID-set test ties disk artifact to live projection (`168–184`). Low risk; extra on-disk scan would harden CI only.

---

## Test quality

- Behavioral: projection, filters, adversarial params, SSR markup, nav contracts — not source grep alone (anti-hardcode `256–262` is supplementary).
- `p3b-hubs-ui` uses `AppShell` ≡ `ShellLayout` wrapper (`ShellLayout.tsx` 11`).
- P3A preservation covered (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 292–309).

---

## APPROVE evidence (concise)

1. Membership is **derived** from learner `byKind` with **destination guard**; tests prove **0 diff** vs independent sets and `learner-hubs.json` IDs.  
2. **Publication boundary** is double-gated (index facade + `projectHubRecord` + `assertHubProjection`).  
3. **Query path** is bounded, first-wins for arrays, no raw markup in summary/filter state; German alias matching tested without folding display labels.  
4. **Nav/404** matches packet: `current: null` on not-found; mobile Hubs current for hub routes; concepts desktop not current (1× `aria-current`).  
5. **P3BR1 timing fix** is narrowly scoped (spawn + describe timeout, no assertion weakening).

Worker-reported command exits were **not re-run** (read-only); code and tests support those claims.

**No approval claim transferred** — this is an independent Composer review only, per your request.
